confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge for July 2026, not from inspected listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; July hostel and hotel rates vary widely with demand, so accommodation is less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2 times, wine glass about 1.1 times) because direct knowledge of Athens bar prices is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to mid-priced southern European capitals with heavy summer tourism, such as Lisbon and Rome; restaurant anchors reflect Greek taverna pricing.
